claim: A statistical classifier built from the 30 annual indicators of a country distinguishes the country-years in which a civil war begins from the country-years in which none begins, with an area under the ROC curve of at least 0.75 on new country-years.

data_keys.meaning: 30 annual political, economic and demographic indicators of the country in that year
True when a civil war begins in that country-year

claim: A classifier built from the 12 clinical measurements detects at least 60% of the patients who have the less frequent outcome among new patients (sensitivity of at least 0.60).

data_keys.meaning: 12 clinical measurements of each patient
True when the patient has the less frequent of the two outcomes

claim: A classifier built from the 50 sensor features separates defective units from sound units with a balanced accuracy (mean of sensitivity and specificity) of at least 0.65 on new units.

data_keys.meaning: 50 features computed from the sensor recording of each unit
True when the unit is defective

claim: A classifier built from the 10 daily indicators predicts whether the series rises over the following day with an accuracy of at least 0.58 on later days.

data_keys.meaning: 10 indicators observed on each day, days in chronological order
True when the series rises over the day that follows

claim: A regression on the 8 weekly drivers explains at least 30% of the variance of weekly demand in later weeks (R-squared of at least 0.30).

data_keys.meaning: 8 weather and calendar drivers of each week, weeks in chronological order
demand observed in that week

claim: A classifier built from the 20 image features of a tissue patch identifies malignant tissue in patches from new patients with an area under the ROC curve of at least 0.75.

data_keys.meaning: 20 image features of each tissue patch of each patient
True when the patient's tissue is malignant

claim: A regression on the 10 session measurements predicts a participant's score in a session, with a Pearson correlation of at least 0.30 between predicted and observed scores for new participants.

data_keys.meaning: 10 measurements recorded in each session of each participant
score of the participant in that session

claim: A shrunken-centroid classifier built from the 1000 gene-expression measurements separates the two tumour classes with an accuracy of at least 0.60 on new samples.

data_keys.meaning: expression level of each gene in each tumour sample
True when the sample belongs to the second tumour class

claim: A shrunken-centroid classifier built from the 1000 gene-expression measurements separates patients who respond to the treatment from those who do not, with an area under the ROC curve of at least 0.65 on new patients.

data_keys.meaning: expression level of each gene in the tumour of each patient
True when the patient responds to the treatment

claim: A kernel-based classifier built from the 1000 gene-expression measurements separates the two tumour classes with an accuracy of at least 0.60 on new samples.

data_keys.meaning: expression level of each gene in each tumour sample
True when the sample belongs to the second tumour class

claim: A classifier built from the 1000 gene-expression measurements separates the two groups of subjects with a balanced accuracy (mean of sensitivity and specificity) of at least 0.60 on new subjects.

data_keys.meaning: expression level of each gene in the blood sample of each subject
True when the subject belongs to the second group

claim: A classifier that uses three genes distinguishes tumour from normal colon tissue with an accuracy of at least 0.70 on new tissue samples.

data_keys.meaning: expression level of each gene in each colon tissue sample
True when the tissue sample is tumour tissue
